lines.label: B1
lines.reason: About a 24 deg formed bend between the 10 mm vertical web and the sloped edge flange (y~25). The tangent-vs-arclength profile shows a sharp 3 to 27.5 deg step over about 2 mm at every station. The line sits on the convex (left, x~-26.9) skin's apex: it is the outermost point along the bisector at every 6 mm station from z=-72 to -12, the nearest point is 0.02-0.19 mm away, and on the 25/50/75% perpendicular sections it is 0.1-0.2 mm from the mid-transition. The fold where both plates exist runs from z=-76.3 to -7.5 (68.8 mm). The flange tab below z=-76.3 has no web on the other side. The line runs from z=-75.67 to -8.71 (67.0 mm), about 97%, and is parallel.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: About a 21-22 deg formed reverse bend at y~15, where the large-radius roll (tangent rising to +25 deg) meets the vertical web (tangent ~3 deg). It is a sharp curvature reversal over about 2-3 mm on both skins at the 25/50/75% stations, so it is a discrete crease, not a gentle roll kink. The line sits on the convex (right, x~-26) skin's apex: it is the outermost point along the bisector at all stations and 0.01-0.19 mm from the nearest point. The fold runs from z=-76.3 to -7.5 (68.8 mm). The line runs from z=-75.0 to -8.5 (66.5 mm), about 97%, and is parallel.
